items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I mentioned one but you don't know him. He's a drummer, very good drummer, name was Pinky ( ? ).

ctx.x: White and black belonged to the same local?
They did a little fighting in there... Pinky I don't know if you know him. He was a drummer. So you know,
one musician is a Negro, want to be this and one want to be something else - boy, they had a fight down there one day.
